careSettings.title: Automatic follow-up
careSettings.description: The AI writes again to customers who went quiet or are about to buy, while Messenger still allows it.
careSettings.usageUnlimited: The AI wrote {{used}} follow-ups today (no limit)
careSettings.metaRule: Messenger and Instagram let a page message a customer only within 24 hours of the customer's last message. The AI follows up only inside that window; after 24 hours the customer stays on Today for your team to decide.
careSettings.loadError: Could not load the follow-up settings.

when.silent: Exploring or asked the price, then went quiet: a message after 2 hours, a last one after 21 hours.
when.ready: About to buy but no order yet: after 1 hour, a recap of their choice and how to order.
when.after_sale: No automatic message: the customer appears under “Follow up today” a few days after the order is completed.

placeholder.silent: E.g. Call the customer “chị”. Mention free shipping over 500k.
placeholder.ready: E.g. Include the bank details and offer same-day delivery.
